Question 2
?

Find the gradient vector field of the function f(x,y)=ln⁡(2x+4y).

a
 42x+4yi+22x+4yj
b
 22x+yi+12x+yj
c
 4x+yi+2x+yj
d
 12x+4yi+12x+4yj
e
1x+2yi+2x+2yj
